name: Manazuru (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Manazuru town emblem in red: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised crane's head and beak.
history: Municipal flag of Manazuru, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1954.

features.role: Manazuru town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised crane's head and beak
